title: School Review
before:
The Maine DOE's Career and Technical Education (CTE) team conducts two unique reviews- The Comprehensive School Review and Methods of Administration.

Comprehensive School Review: The Comprehensive School Review process is designed to serve two important and interrelated purposes: public accountability and institutional improvement.  

Methods of Administration: The U.S. Department of Education Office of Civil Rights requires the Maine Department of Education to conduct career and technical education (CTE) site visits as part of its Vocational Education Methods of Administration (MOA) civil rights compliance of districts that receive federal funding. On-site reviews are based on the following U.S. DOE regulations as well as U.S. Department of Justice regulations. 

Danielle Despins
CTE School Review and Equity Coordinator
Phone: 207-592-1448
Email: danielle.r.despins@maine.gov

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 1 address is shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — danielle.r.despins@maine.gov → Danielle.r.Despins@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Set a job title the way the rest of the site does
decisions.why: 1 job title sits in plain text under the person's name, where 186 elsewhere on the site are in italics — so the same contact block is drawn two ways depending on the page, and the title runs into the name above it. The standard here is the site's own, not a preference: two thirds of these blocks already do it. No word changes.
